supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded c.rwong being created at 13:47:06 UTC by ruth.moss, rather than at the alert's approximate 13:42 time.

A domain logon for ruth.moss from 10.54.10.24 was recorded shortly before account creation, and the account-creation event uses that logon's ID. The same address is associated with WS-RMOSS-01 and ruth.moss in proxy telemetry.
The new account uses the c.<name> temporary-account pattern and was added to the Seasonal group, consistent with the stated help-desk account-creation practice.
The recorded creator is the help-desk account ruth.moss, an account authorized by the supplied environment context to create domain accounts.

known_telemetry_limitations: The evidence does not include an account-request ticket or other approval record.
The supplied records do not show whether c.rwong subsequently signed in or what actions the account took.
The account-creation record contains a raw UserAccountControl value, but the evidence does not establish the account's effective settings or validate them against the request.
claims_not_established: That the creation was specifically requested or approved by a business owner.
That ruth.moss personally performed the activity, rather than someone using her session or credentials.
That c.rwong received administrator privileges; the supplied group-add record shows Seasonal, but the evidence is not a complete account-privilege audit.
unrelated_findings: Dropbox, which is not among the approved services, was launched under ruth.moss on WS-RMOSS-01. This is separate from the account creation, and these records do not establish file transfer or exfiltration. (T218-00009, T218-00010, T218-00011)

A successful request to a Google Docs document was recorded from WS-RMOSS-01, although Google Docs is not listed as an approved service. This does not establish that a document was uploaded or shared. (T218-00020, T218-00021)

A request to id.atlassian.com was denied by the proxy, and a request to dash.cloudflare.com/login was recorded. These are separate observations and do not establish successful access or account-alert involvement. (T218-00005, T218-00035)
